claims: Team USA is competing in the 2026 World Baseball Classic quarterfinals facing Canada.
Team USA's quarterfinal against Canada is on Friday, March 13, at 8 p.m. ET in Houston.
Team USA's quarterfinal against Canada airs on FOX.
Team USA's semifinal if advancing is against the Dominican Republic on Sunday, March 15, at 8 p.m. ET in Miami.
Team USA's semifinal airs on FS1.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game is scheduled for Tuesday, March 17, at 8 p.m. ET in Miami.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game airs on FS1.
Team USA finished 3-1 in Pool B play to advance to the quarterfinals.
Team USA's squad features Paul Skenes, Tarik Skubal, and Mason Miller.
The USA Women's National Team has training camps scheduled for June and July.
The WBSC Women's Baseball World Cup Group Stage is from July 22-26.
